project.name: VexelRay GUI :: Recorder
project.description: The flight recorder: a fixed ring of the probe's recent rows, held inside the application and fed by a live sink, and the questions asked of it (recorder, rows, gaps, frames, why). Every answer is a plain immutable record, and the text reply is a pure function of that record, so the same answer can travel any transport. Depends on atchung-probe alone: no GUI type, no bus type, no serialization library. See docs/plans/flight-recorder.md.
